## Concerns
- claim-1: Exhaustiveness is asserted but not proved. The draft should classify all size-\(3\) extensions of \(i^j\) and verify that each Pieri row contains every admissible horizontal strip.
- claim-1: The required independent matrix check is circular as written: \(R_{\mathrm{selected}}\) is defined using the same Pieri table that defines \(R_{\mathrm{full}}\), while \(C\) is chosen as coordinate inclusion. Thus \(R_{\mathrm{full}}=CR_{\mathrm{selected}}\) holds definitionally rather than by an independently checkable matrix multiplication.
- The \(i=2\) explanation is inaccurate: \(H\) is unavailable because the below-rectangle partition \((3)\) exceeds width \(i\), not because an invalid sequence may be sorted into \(F\).

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Classify all degree-\(d+3\) targets and horizontal-strip extensions, then explicitly display the independently obtained matrices \(C\), \(R_{\mathrm{selected}}\), \(CR_{\mathrm{selected}}\), and the boundary-masked \(R_{\mathrm{full}}\), and compare their entries without defining one from the other.
